name: Generate Draft  (upload + refs + style -> design image)

parameters.jsCode:
const generation_id = $json.generation_id || 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, c => { const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0; return (c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8)).toString(16); });
return [{
  json: {
    generation_id,
    user_id:              $json.user_id,
    session_id:           $json.session_id || null,
    parent_generation_id: $json.parent_generation_id || null,
    kind:                 $json.kind,
    input_image_path:     $json.input_image_path || null,
    output_image_path:    `user-outputs/${$json.user_id}/${generation_id}.png`,
    room_type:            $json.room_type || null,
    style_tag:            $json.style_tag || null,
    reference_image_ids:  $json.reference_image_ids || null,
    prompt:               $json.prompt || null,
    criteria:             $json.criteria || null,
    model_config:         $json.model_config || 'A',
    model_id:             $json.model_id || null,
    latency_ms:           $json.latency_ms || null,
    cost_usd:             $json.cost_usd || 0
  },
  binary: $input.first().binary
}];
